source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 12 (PDF 261-279), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
12.1 Structure and properties of the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
1 Experiments confirmed that particles such as nucleons have even smaller constituents. These constituents were named:
(Tajurbaat ne sabit kiya ke nucleons jaise particles ke andar aur bhi chhote ajza hain. In ajza ka naam kya rakha gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Physicists ne mazeed bunyadi ajza talash kiye jo tajurbaat se sabit hue; in ka naam quarks rakha gaya (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These were named as quarks.

blocks.prompt:
2 The mesons discovered by the end of the 1960s mostly had masses:
(1960s ke aakhir tak daryaft hone wale mesons ka mass zyada tar kaisa tha?)

options.text: nucleon se kam magar electron se zyada

blocks.explanation: Un mesons ka mass zyada tar nucleon se kam magar electron se zyada tha (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These were called mesons whose masses were mostly less than nucleon masses but more than the electron mass.

blocks.prompt:
3 The nucleus of protium, the simplest hydrogen atom, consists of:
(Protium (sab se saada hydrogen atom) ka nucleus kis par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proton sab se saade atom, hydrogen (protium) ka nucleus hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: A proton is the nucleus of the simplest atom, hydrogen, called a protium.

blocks.prompt:
4 The charge on a proton is:
(Proton par charge kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proton ka charge positive hai aur magnitude electron ke barabar, yani 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The proton has a positive charge of the same magnitude as that of the electron

blocks.prompt:
5 The mass of a proton is about:
(Proton ka mass taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proton ka mass 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: its mass is 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg

blocks.prompt:
6 The existence of the neutron was pointed out in 1932 by:
(1932 mein neutron ke wujood ki nishandahi kis ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Neutron ka wujood 1932 mein James Chadwick ne bataya (12.1).

book_ref.quote: whose existence was pointed out in 1932 by James Chadwick

blocks.prompt:
7 The protons and neutrons inside a nucleus are together called:
(Nucleus ke andar protons aur neutrons ko mil kar kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ke do qisam ke particles, neutrons aur protons, nucleons kehlate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Now we can say that the nucleus has two types of particles (neutrons and protons) called nucleons.

blocks.prompt:
8 The different nuclei of the elements are called:
(Anaasir (elements) ke mukhtalif nuclei ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif nuclei ko nuclides kehte hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The different nuclei are called nuclides.

blocks.prompt:
9 The atomic number Z of a nucleus is the number of:
(Kisi nucleus ka atomic number Z kis cheez ki tadaad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus mein protons ki tadaad atomic number Z hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The number of protons in a nucleus is called the atomic number represented by the symbol Z.

blocks.prompt:
10 A nucleus has mass number A = 40 and atomic number Z = 18. Its neutron number N is:
(Aik nucleus ka mass number A = 40 aur atomic number Z = 18 hai. Us ka neutron number N kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: where N represents the neutron number.

blocks.prompt:
11 A nucleus contains 15 protons and 16 neutrons. Its mass number A is:
(Aik nucleus mein 15 protons aur 16 neutrons hain. Us ka mass number A kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: A nucleons ki kul tadaad hai: A = 15 + 16 = 31 (12.1).

book_ref.quote: is represented by the symbol A and is called the atomic mass number

blocks.prompt:
12 One unified mass unit (1 u) is defined as exactly:
(Aik unified mass unit (1 u) ki definition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek baarhwan hissa (1/12) hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: By definition 1u is exactly one twelveth the mass of carbon¹² atom

blocks.prompt:
13 In energy units, 1 u is equivalent to:
(Energy ki units mein 1 u kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 931 MeV (12.1).

book_ref.quote: To indicate the mass of atomic particles, instead of kilogram, unified mass scale (u) is generally used.

blocks.prompt:
14 Using 1 u = 931 MeV, by how much does the rest-mass energy of a neutron (1.008665 u) exceed that of a proton (1.007276 u)?
(1 u = 931 MeV le kar, neutron (1.008665 u) ki rest-mass energy proton (1.007276 u) se kitni zyada hai?)

book_ref.quote: In this unit the mass of a proton is 1.007276 u and that of a neutron is 1.008665 u

blocks.prompt:
15 Taking the proton's mass as 1.007276 u and the electron's as 0.00055 u, the proton is about how many times heavier than the electron?
(Proton ka mass 1.007276 u aur electron ka 0.00055 u le kar, proton electron se taqreeban kitne guna bhaari hai?)

book_ref.quote: while that of an electron is 0.00055 u

blocks.prompt:
16 Nuclei having the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons are called:
(Aise nuclei jin mein protons barabar magar neutrons mukhtalif hon, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Protons barabar, neutrons mukhtalif: aise nuclei isotopes (hum-jagah anaasir) kehlate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Nuclei that contain the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons are called isotopes.

blocks.prompt:
17 Which isotope of carbon is unstable and decays into nitrogen?
(Carbon ka kaun sa isotope ghair-mustahkam (unstable) hai aur nitrogen mein badal jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: C-12 aur C-13 mustahkam hain, magar C-14 unstable hai aur β aur neutrino khaarij kar ke nitrogen ban jata hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: is unstable and decays into nitrogen alongwith the emission of β and neutrino particles

blocks.prompt:
18 How many neutrons are there in the carbon isotope with mass number 13?
(Mass number 13 wale carbon isotope mein kitne neutrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon mein hamesha 6 protons hain; N = 13 − 6 = 7 (12.1).

book_ref.quote: For example, carbon nuclei always have 6 protons, but they may have 6, 7 and 8 neutrons.

blocks.prompt:
19 Which one of the following is NOT one of the four fundamental forces?
(In mein se kaun si force chaar bunyadi forces mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar bunyadi forces: gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear aur strong nuclear force (12.2).

book_ref.quote: The four fundamental forces are gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear force, and strong nuclear force.

blocks.prompt:
20 Among the four fundamental forces, gravity is:
(Chaar bunyadi forces mein gravity kaisi force hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity chaaron mein sab se kamzor hai magar lambe faasle (long-range) tak asar karti hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: It is the weakest of the four but it is a long-range force.

blocks.prompt:
21 Gravitational force between particles on an atomic level is considered:
(Atomi satah par particles ke darmiyan gravitational force ko kaisa samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bhaari ajsaam ke liye gravity ahem hai, magar atomi satah par yeh na-qabil-e-zikr had tak kamzor hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: However, on an atomic level, this force is considered to be negligibly weak.

blocks.prompt:
22 Electricity and magnetism were unified into electromagnetism by a set of four equations formulated by:
(Bijli aur magnetism ko chaar equations ke zariye electromagnetism mein kis ne mutahid kiya?)
blocks.explanation: James Clerk Maxwell (1861) ne chaar equations banayin jin se bijli aur magnetism aik ho gaye (12.2).

book_ref.quote: James Clerk Maxwell (1861) formulated a set of four fundamental equations

blocks.prompt:
23 The electromagnetic force resembles the gravitational force in that both:
(Electromagnetic force aur gravitational force mein kya baat mushtarik hai?)

options.text: dono inverse square law maanti hain
dono sirf nucleus ke andar hain

blocks.explanation: Gravity ki tarah electromagnetic force bhi inverse square law (faasle ke murabba ka ulat) maanti hai, magar kahin zyada taaqatwar hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Like the gravitational force, the electromagnetic force follows an inverse square law

blocks.prompt:
24 If only the electromagnetic and gravitational forces acted in a nucleus, the nucleus would:
(Agar nucleus mein sirf electromagnetic aur gravitational forces hoti to nucleus ka kya hota?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf electromagnetism aur gravity se nucleus bikhar jata; us ka qaaim rehna aik taaqatwar nuclear force ki daleel hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: If we only consider the forces of electromagnetism and gravity, the nucleus should fly off in different directions.

blocks.prompt:
25 Strong nuclear forces are called short-range forces because they:
(Strong nuclear forces ko short-range forces kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: sirf nucleus ke andar hoti hain

blocks.explanation: Strong nuclear forces sirf nucleus ke andar hoti hain, is liye short-range (kam faasle wali) hain (12.2).

book_ref.quote: So, we call them as short-range forces.

blocks.prompt:
26 The strong nuclear force acts as an attractive force between:
(Strong nuclear force kin ke darmiyan kashish (attraction) ki force hai?)

options.text: tamam nucleons, protons aur neutrons dono

blocks.explanation: Strong nuclear force tamam nucleons, protons aur neutrons dono ko yaksaan kheenchti hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: The strong nuclear force acts as an attractive force between all nucleons, protons and neutrons alike.

blocks.prompt:
27 Two protons inside a nucleus:
(Nucleus ke andar do protons:)

options.text: strong force se kheenchte aur electric force se dhakelte hain
sirf electric force se kheenchte hain

blocks.explanation: Protons aik doosre ko strong force se kheenchte aur saath hi electric force se dhakelte hain (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Thus, protons attract each other via the strong nuclear force at the same time they repel each other via the electric force.

blocks.prompt:
28 Beta decay is mainly due to the:
(Beta decay zyada tar kis force ki wajah se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Weak nuclear forces radioactive decay, khaas taur par beta decay, ki zimmedar hain (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Weak nuclear forces are responsible for the radioactive decay, particularly the beta decay

blocks.prompt:
29 Which fundamental force can change the identity of particles?
(Kaun si bunyadi force particles ki pehchaan (identity) badal sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosri forces ke baraks weak force particles ki pehchaan badal sakti hai; sitaron mein fusion ke liye yeh zaroori hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Unlike the other fundamental forces, the weak force can change the identity of particles

blocks.prompt:
30 According to Table 12.1, the range of the strong nuclear force is:
(Table 12.1 ke mutabiq strong nuclear force ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1: strong force ki range 10⁻¹⁵ m se kam (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
31 Which fundamental force has the shortest range (less than 10⁻¹⁸ m)?
(Kis bunyadi force ki range sab se kam (10⁻¹⁸ m se kam) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1: weak force ki range 10⁻¹⁸ m se kam hai, jo strong force (10⁻¹⁵ m) se bhi kam hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
32 Which two fundamental forces have infinite range?
(Kin do bunyadi forces ki range la-mehdood (infinite) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1 mein gravity aur electromagnetic force ki range ∞ hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
33 Using the relative strengths in Table 12.1 (electromagnetic 10⁻², gravity 10⁻³⁸), the electromagnetic force is stronger than gravity by a factor of about:
(Table 12.1 ki nisbati taaqat (electromagnetic 10⁻², gravity 10⁻³⁸) se electromagnetic force gravity se kitne guna taaqatwar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
34 By Table 12.1, the strong force is stronger than the weak force by a factor of about:
(Table 12.1 ke mutabiq strong force weak force se kitne guna taaqatwar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Strong = 1, weak = 10⁻¹³; nisbat 1/10⁻¹³ = 10¹³ (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
35 A neutron attracts other nucleons through the:
(Neutron doosre nucleons ko kis force se kheenchta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutron par charge nahi, is liye woh doosre neutrons ya protons ko strong nuclear force se kheenchta hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: A neutron, being electrically neutral, can attract other neutrons or protons via the strong nuclear force.

blocks.prompt:
36 The existence of anti-particles was predicted in 1928 by:
(1928 mein anti-particles ke wujood ki peshgoi kis ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Paul Dirac ne 1928 mein peshgoi ki ke bunyadi particles ke anti-particles hote hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: It was predicted by Paul Dirac in 1928 that the fundamental particles have their anti-particles.

blocks.prompt:
37 Compared with its particle, an anti-particle has:
(Apne particle ke muqable mein anti-particle mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anti-particle ka rest mass particle ke barabar magar charge ulta hota hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The rest masses of the anti-particles are the same as that of their corresponding particles but with opposite charges.

blocks.prompt:
38 Anderson discovered the positron in 1932 in a:
(Anderson ne 1932 mein positron kis mein daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Anderson ne 1932 mein cloud chamber ke tajurbe mein positron daryaft kiya (12.3).

book_ref.quote: by Anderson in 1932 in a cloud chamber experiment

blocks.prompt:
39 An anti-particle is usually represented by:
(Anti-particle ko aam taur par kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anti-particle ko harf ke oopar lakeer (bar) laga kar likhte hain, maslan p̄, ν̄ (12.3).

book_ref.quote: Usually, the anti-particle are represented by a letter with a bar over it

blocks.prompt:
40 The antiproton was discovered in 1955 by:
(1955 mein antiproton kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1955 mein Segre aur Chamberlain ne particle accelerator se antiproton daryaft kiya (12.3).

book_ref.quote: In 1955, Segre and Chamberlain discovered antiproton using a particle accelerator

blocks.prompt:
41 Which one of the following is NOT a particle accelerator?
(In mein se kaun sa particle accelerator NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Linear accelerator, cyclotron aur betatron particle accelerators hain; cloud chamber mein positron dekha gaya tha (12.3).

book_ref.quote: Linear Accelerators, Cyclotrons and Betatrons are important particle accelerators.

blocks.prompt:
42 Cosmic rays coming from outer space consist mostly of:
(Khala se aane wali cosmic rays zyada tar kis par mushtamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cosmic rays zyada tar protons, neutrons aur bhaari nuclei par mushtamil hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: These particles consist mostly of protons, neutrons and heavier nuclei

blocks.prompt:
43 Among the many discovered particles, the two groups recognized as elementary particles are:
(Bohat se daryaft shuda particles mein se kaun se do giroh elementary (bunyadi) particles maane gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Quarks aur leptons bunyadi (elementary) particles maane gaye hain; in ke antiparticles bhi hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The quarks and leptons have been recognized as the fundamental particles

blocks.prompt:
44 When accelerated charged particles collide head-on, the debris may contain:
(Jab tez kiye gaye charged particles aamne saamne takraate hain to malbe (debris) mein kya mil sakta hai?)

options.text: pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons tak

blocks.explanation: Aisi takkar ke malbe mein pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons tak hote hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: the debris from these reactions contain particles like pions, kaons, muons and even antiprotons

blocks.prompt:
45 Pair production takes place when a high-energy gamma ray photon:
(Pair production kab hoti hai jab high-energy gamma ray photon:)

options.text: khaali khala mein safar karta hai
sirf ruke hue electron se takraata hai
neutrino mein jazb ho jata hai
atomi nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai

blocks.explanation: Gamma photon jab atomi nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai to electron-positron jora banta hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: Pair production occurs when a gamma ray photon (high energy photon) passes nearby an atomic nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
46 In pair production, a nucleus is necessary in order to conserve:
(Pair production mein nucleus kis cheez ko conserve (mehfooz) rakhne ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teesra particle (nucleus) linear momentum conserve rakhne ke liye zaroori hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The presence of a third particle, such as a nucleus, is necessary to conserve linear momentum.

blocks.prompt:
47 The minimum photon energy needed to create an electron-positron pair is:
(Electron-positron jora banane ke liye photon ki kam se kam energy kitni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Kam se kam energy jore ki rest mass energy ke barabar hai: 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The rest mass energy of the electron-positron pair is 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV

blocks.prompt:
48 A 1.80 MeV gamma photon produces an electron-positron pair. The total kinetic energy of the pair is:
(1.80 MeV ka gamma photon electron-positron jora banata hai. Jore ki kul kinetic energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: KE = 1.80 − 1.02 = 0.78 MeV; 1.02 MeV se zaaid energy kinetic energy ban jati hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: the excess energy goes into the kinetic energies of the particles

blocks.prompt:
49 A gamma photon of energy 0.90 MeV passes near a nucleus. What happens?
(0.90 MeV ka gamma photon nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai. Kya hoga?)

options.text: 0.12 MeV KE wala jora banta hai

blocks.explanation: 0.90 MeV < 1.02 MeV, is liye photon electron-positron jora nahi bana sakta (12.3).

book_ref.quote: A gamma ray photon with energy less than 1.02 MeV cannot produce an electron-positron pair

blocks.prompt:
50 A 3.02 MeV photon creates an electron-positron pair. If the kinetic energy is shared equally, each particle gets:
(3.02 MeV ka photon electron-positron jora banata hai. Agar kinetic energy barabar bante to har particle ko kitni milegi?)
blocks.explanation: Zaaid energy = 3.02 − 1.02 = 2.00 MeV; har aik ko 2.00/2 = 1.00 MeV (12.3).

book_ref.quote: the excess energy goes into the kinetic energies of the particles

blocks.prompt:
51 Pair production cannot take place:
(Pair production kahan nahi ho sakti?)

options.text: khala (vacuum) mein, kisi nucleus se door

blocks.explanation: Pair production ke liye nucleus jaisa bairooni jism chahiye jo recoil kare; khala (vacuum) mein yeh nahi hoti (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The pair production cannot take place in vacuum or space.

blocks.prompt:
52 In pair production the total charge before and after the process is:
(Pair production mein amal se pehle aur baad kul charge kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photon par charge nahi aur jore ka −e + e = 0; charge, momentum aur energy conserve rehte hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The process of pair production satisfies the laws of conservation of charge, momentum and energy.

blocks.prompt:
53 Annihilation of matter is the opposite process of:
(Annihilation of matter kis amal ka ulat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Annihilation (fana hona) pair production ka ulat amal hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: It is the opposite process of pair production.

blocks.prompt:
54 When an electron and a positron at rest annihilate, each of the two gamma photons has energy:
(Jab saakin electron aur positron annihilate hote hain to do gamma photons mein se har aik ki energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy m₀c² ke barabar hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: The energy of each gamma ray photon is 0.51 MeV

blocks.prompt:
55 Using 1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J, the total energy released when an electron and a positron at rest annihilate (1.02 MeV) is:
(1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J le kar, saakin electron aur positron ke annihilation (1.02 MeV) mein kul kitni energy niklti hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = 1.02 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ = 1.63 × 10⁻¹³ J; annihilation mein energy conserve rehti hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: In an annihilation reaction energy and momentum are conserved.

blocks.prompt:
56 Besides electron and positron, annihilation can also occur between:
(Electron aur positron ke ilawa annihilation kin ke darmiyan bhi ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre particles aur un ke anti-particles ka annihilation bhi hota hai, maslan proton aur antiproton (12.3).

book_ref.quote: the annihilation reactions of other particles and their anti-particles can also be carried out

blocks.prompt:
57 High energy collisions at CERN have shown that part of the mass of colliding particles changes into:
(CERN mein high energy takkaron se pata chala ke takraane wale particles ke mass ka kuch hissa kis mein badal jata hai?)

options.text: kuch nahi; mass waisa hi rehta hai
electromagnetic radiation mein, aur baqi mass naye particles ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Kuch mass Einstein ki equation se electromagnetic radiation ban jata hai aur baqi mass naye sub-atomic particles ki shakal mein aata hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: High energy collisions between the particles at CERN have revealed

blocks.prompt:
58 Nuclei are found naturally unstable (radioactive) when their atomic number is greater than:
(Kis atomic number se zyada wale nuclei qudrati taur par unstable (radioactive) hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jin nuclei ka atomic number 82 se zyada ho woh qudrati taur par unstable hain aur khud ba khud radiation khaarij karte hain (12.4).

book_ref.quote: the nuclei whose atomic numbers are greater than 82 are found naturally unstable

blocks.prompt:
59 When a stable element is bombarded with high-energy particles and becomes radioactive, the process is called:
(Jab kisi stable element par high-energy particles barsa kar use radioactive bana diya jaye to is amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stable element par neutrons, protons, alpha ya gamma barsa kar unstable banana artificial (masnoo'i) radioactivity hai (12.4).

book_ref.quote: This is called artificial radioactivity

blocks.prompt:
60 In an electric field, α-particles bend towards the negative terminal. This shows that they:
(Electric field mein α-particles negative terminal ki taraf mudte hain. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Negative terminal ki taraf mudna batata hai ke α-particles par positive charge hai (12.4).

book_ref.quote: α-particles deflect towards the negative terminal of the electric field

blocks.prompt:
61 β-particles are deflected more than α-particles in an electric field because β-particles are:
(Electric field mein β-particles α-particles se zyada kyun mudte hain?)
blocks.explanation: β-particles ka zyada mudna sabit karta hai ke woh α-particles se halke hain (12.4).

book_ref.quote: The deflection of β-particles is more than the α-particles

blocks.prompt:
62 Taking the speed of light as 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, the greatest speed of β-particles stated in the chapter (0.9995 of c) is:
(Roshni ki raftaar 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ le kar, β-particles ki chapter mein di gayi zyada se zyada raftaar (c ka 0.9995) kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: move with speeds up to 0.9995 of the speed of light

blocks.prompt:
63 γ-radiations pass through an electric field without deflection, which shows that they:
(γ-radiations electric field mein se baghair mude guzar jati hain. Is se kya sabit hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Na mudna batata hai ke γ-radiations par koi charge nahi (12.4).

book_ref.quote: The γ-radiations passed through the electric field without deflection

blocks.prompt:
64 γ-radiations consist of:
(γ-radiations kis par mushtamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: γ-radiations electromagnetic radiations hain jo photons par mushtamil hain aur roshni ki raftaar se chalti hain (12.4).

book_ref.quote: The γ-radiations are electromagnetic radiations which consist of photons.

blocks.prompt:
65 α-particles travel only several centimetres in air because of their:
(α-particles hawa mein sirf chand centimetre kyun chalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bhaari mass ki wajah se α-particles hawa mein sirf chand centimetre chalte hain (12.4).

book_ref.quote: α-particles can travel only several centimetres in the air due to their large mass

blocks.prompt:
66 α-particles are emitted at speeds that are typically:
(α-particles aam taur par kis raftaar se khaarij hote hain?)

options.text: roshni ki raftaar ke chand feesad

blocks.explanation: α-particles roshni ki raftaar ke chand feesad ki tez raftaar se nikalte hain (12.4).

book_ref.quote: typically a few percent of the speed of light

blocks.prompt:
67 An α-particle is equivalent to:
(α-particle kis ke barabar hai?)

options.text: helium ka nucleus (do protons, do neutrons)

blocks.explanation: α-particle helium ka nucleus hai: do protons aur do neutrons (12.4).

book_ref.quote: An α-particle is equivalent to a helium (He) nucleus which consists of two protons and two neutrons.

blocks.prompt:
68 In α-decay the parent nucleus:
(α-decay mein parent nucleus mein kya tabdeeli aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do protons aur do neutrons nikalne se Z do aur A chaar kam ho jata hai (Eq. 12.2).

book_ref.quote: Hence the atomic number Z decreases by two while its mass number A decreases by four.

blocks.prompt:
69 A nucleus with A = 210 and Z = 84 emits an α-particle. The daughter nucleus has:
(A = 210 aur Z = 84 wala nucleus aik α-particle khaarij karta hai. Daughter nucleus ka kya hoga?)

book_ref.quote: is the parent nucleus which decays into the daughter nucleus

blocks.prompt:
70 The change of one element into another by radioactive decay is called:
(Radioactive decay se aik element ka doosre element mein badalna kya kehlata hai?)

blocks.explanation: Kainaat taqreeban poori maadde (matter) par hai, antimatter par nahi; yahi asymmetry hai (12.9).

book_ref.quote: the universe consists almost entirely of matter rather than antimatter

blocks.prompt:
143 In the composition of the universe, the contribution of antihydrogen or anti-helium atoms is:
(Kainaat ki banawat mein antihydrogen ya anti-helium atoms ka hissa kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kainaat ki banawat mein antihydrogen ya anti-helium ka koi hissa nahi (12.9).

book_ref.quote: there are no any contribution of antihydrogen or anti-helium atoms

blocks.prompt:
144 The problem of the asymmetry of matter and antimatter is, according to the chapter:
(Chapter ke mutabiq matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry ka masla:)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ka nateeja hai ke matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry abhi tak aik raaz hai (12.9).

book_ref.quote: Hence, it is concluded that the problem asymmetry of matter and antimatter is still mystery.

blocks.text: 12.10 Most of the matter in the observable universe is plasma

blocks.prompt:
145 The unknown matter that makes up about 27% of the universe is called:
(Kainaat ka taqreeban 27% hissa banane wala na-maloom maadda kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kainaat ka taqreeban 27% na-maloom maadda dark matter kehlata hai (12.10).

book_ref.quote: our universe consists of about 27% of unknown matter called dark matter

blocks.prompt:
146 Dark energy makes up about what percentage of the universe?
(Dark energy kainaat ka taqreeban kitna feesad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kainaat ka taqreeban 68% dark energy hai (12.10).

book_ref.quote: about 68% a mysterious antigravity material known as dark energy

blocks.prompt:
147 Dark matter (27%) and dark energy (68%) together make up what part of the universe that we know nothing about?
(Dark matter (27%) aur dark energy (68%) mil kar kainaat ka kitna hissa hain jis ke baare mein hum kuch nahi jaante?)
blocks.explanation: 27% + 68% = 95%; hum kainaat ke sirf 5% ke baare mein jaante hain (12.10).

book_ref.quote: It means 95% universe is out of our thinking

blocks.prompt:
148 Most of the matter in the observable universe is in the:
(Qabil-e-mushahida kainaat ka zyada tar maadda kis haalat mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen aur helium taqreeban plasma haalat mein hain, is liye zyada tar maadda plasma hai (12.10).

book_ref.quote: Hence, it is concluded that most of the matter in the observable universe is plasma.

blocks.text: 12.11 The theories about the forces between the masses of particles

blocks.prompt:
149 The two theories mentioned to explain the interactions between particles through mediators are:
(Mediators ke zariye particles ke ta'amul ko samjhane ke liye kaun si do theories bayan ki gayi hain?)

options.text: quantum field theory aur string theory

blocks.explanation: Mediators ke zariye ta'amul quantum field theory aur string theory se samjhaya jata hai (12.11).

book_ref.quote: we have the following two theories, the quantum field theory and the string theory

blocks.prompt:
150 In quantum field theory, the quanta that exchange momentum and energy between particles are called:
(Quantum field theory mein woh quanta jo particles ke darmiyan momentum aur energy ka tabadla karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Field mein momentum aur energy ka tabadla karne wale quanta field particles kehlate hain (12.11).

book_ref.quote: are called field particles

blocks.prompt:
151 In quantum field theory, the field particles that mediate interactions are all:
(Quantum field theory mein interactions karwane wale field particles sab ke sab kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interactions field particles ke tabadle se hoti hain jo sab bosons hain (12.11).

book_ref.quote: the exchange of field particle or quanta which are all bosons

blocks.prompt:
152 In quantum field theory, the electromagnetic force is mediated by:
(Quantum field theory mein electromagnetic force kis ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electromagnetic field ke quanta, photons, electromagnetic force le jate hain (12.11).

book_ref.quote: the electromagnetic force is mediated by photons called quanta of the electromagnetic field

blocks.prompt:
153 According to string theory, the fundamental particles are:
(String theory ke mutabiq bunyadi particles kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: String theory kehti hai ke bunyadi particles nuqte nahi balke nanhe thartharate strings (taar) hain (12.11).

book_ref.quote: are actually tiny vibrating strings

blocks.prompt:
154 In string theory, the properties of a particle, such as mass, are determined by:
(String theory mein particle ki khususiyaat, jaise mass, kis se tay hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Strings khule ya band loops ho sakte hain; un ki tharthrahat particle ki khususiyaat, mass aur force samet, tay karti hai (12.11).

book_ref.quote: their vibrations determine the properties of particles

blocks.prompt:
155 String theory, a possible 'theory of everything', is at present:
(String theory, jo mumkina 'theory of everything' hai, is waqt kis haal mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: String theory abhi tak tajurbe se sabit nahi hui (12.11).

book_ref.quote: still remains unproved experimentally

blocks.prompt:
156 The standard model is:
(Standard model kya hai?)

options.text: theories ka majmua jo sab se chhote particles aur un ke ta'amul bayan karta hai

blocks.explanation: Standard model un theories ka majmua hai jo sab se chhote dekhe gaye particles aur energy-maadde ke ta'amul ko bayan karti hain (12.12).

book_ref.quote: The standard model is the collection of theories

blocks.prompt:
157 In the standard model, matter (only 5% of the universe) is composed of:
(Standard model mein maadda (kainaat ka sirf 5%) kis se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maadda quarks aur leptons se bana hai (12.12).

book_ref.quote: Matter, which makes up only 5% of the universe is composed of quarks and leptons.

blocks.prompt:
158 Which force is NOT provided by the fundamental bosons of the standard model?
(Standard model ke fundamental bosons kaun si force faraham NAHI karte?)
blocks.explanation: Fundamental bosons electromagnetism, strong aur weak force dete hain; gravity woh cheez hai jo model wazeh nahi kar sakta (12.12).

book_ref.quote: The fundamental bosons provide three forces

blocks.prompt:
159 The standard model is considered incomplete because it cannot explain:
(Standard model ko na-mukammal kyun samjha jata hai?)

options.text: gravity, dark matter aur dark energy

blocks.explanation: Model gravity, dark matter (27%) aur dark energy (68%) ko wazeh nahi kar sakta (12.12).

book_ref.quote: This model is still considered incomplete.
